title: 電気エネルギー伝送工学
subtitle: Electric Power Transmission and Distribution
educationalGoal: Students will (1) learn various power transmission apparatus and systems. (2) learn various power distribution apparatus and systems.
advice: Course description 1. Power system and 3 phase AC circuit 2. Transformer 3. Transmission and Distribution (T&D) system 4. Protection devises 5. Resistance, inductance and capacitance of power line 6. Fault current calculation methods 7. Grounding methods 8. Power system stability 9. High voltage DC (HVDC) Expectations To understand the lecture well, knowledge about “3 phase AC circuit”, “electromagnetics” and “transient phenomena in liner circuits” are required.
books: Textbooks: Fundamentals of power transmission and distribution (in Japanese) ISBN978-7-627-74192-8 Reference books: electrical energy transmission engineering (in Japanese) ISBN978-4-274-13183-7
requiredKnowledge: This course is strongly related with the following courses: “Electric Circuits”, “Electromagnetics”, “Transient Phenomena in Linear Circuits”, “Electrical Machinery”, “Generation of Electrical Energy”, and “High-voltage Pulsed Power Engineering”. It’s necessary to review the basic knowledges obtained from those related courses in advance.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the outline of power system (transmission, distribution and substation)
Be able to understand the power transmission and distribution systems
Be able to understand protection devices
Be able to understand the fault current calculation methods
Be able to understand the outline of grounding methods, power system stability and HVDC

lessons.content: [Guidance] [1. power system and 3 phase AC circuit] *outline of a power transmission system *3 phase AC circuit *star and delta connections *active, reactive and apparent power
[2. power transmission and distribution systems] power transmission and distribution system, transformer
[3. calculation of power transmission and distribution systems 1] voltage-drop in power transmission and distribution system
[3. calculation of power transmission and distribution systems 2] *power factor improvement using a capacitor bank *calculation of sag and tension in transmission line
[Quiz 1] *Evaluation targets are the class numbers 1 and 2. *Self-check of understanding level
lessons.assignments: To review the contents of the lecture 1 to 4

lessons.content: [4. protection devises] *Circuit bresker, relay, arrester [5. resistance, inductance, and capacitance of conductor] *calculation of resistance, inductance and capacitance of conductor
[8. fault current calculation 1] *percentage impedance and per unit *calculations of 3 phase short circuit current
[8. fault current calculation 2] *method of symmetrical coordinates *single line to ground fault (example)
[Quiz 2] *Evaluation targets are class numbers 6 and 9. *Self-check of understanding level
lessons.assignments: To review the contents of the lecture 6 to 9

lessons.content: [9. 3rd harmonics and grounding system] *generation of 3rd harmonics from transformer *various systems of grounding
[10. power system stability] *steady-state stability, transient power stability and dynamic stability
[Self-reflection class] *Self-check of understanding level * Questionnaire of the lecture [Examination] *Evaluation of the achievement level of program objectives
lessons.assignments: To review the contents of the lecture 1 to 13

lessons.content: [Self-check lecture] *Explanation of results evaluation method *Notice of evaluation results *Questionnaire of the lecture
